newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann to sell off property units - paper.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann to sell off property units - paper.

text.p: Troubled German construction group Philipp Holzmann AG plans to sell off some 4,000 property holdings in a deal that could generate as much as 500 million marks, the Frankfurter Rundschau newspaper said on Friday.
The newspaper, quoting a company spokesman, said Holzmann was holding talks on the sale of the properties -- mainly sited in Berlin and Bonn -- with potential buyers.
A company spokesman confirmed that talks were underway to sell the properties but declined to comment on possible proceeds from the sale.
"We have no further comment to make," he said.
Holzmann posted a surprise loss of 443 million marks in 1995 after incurring about 485 million marks in writedowns on its property portfolio.

The company, whose problems have been exacerbated by the slump in the German building sector, has said it hopes to break even in 1996, but will have to dissolve some hidden reserves to offset a negative operating result.
